name: Dev "404" Rathore

power.name: Chaos Pattern
power.description: Connects things that shouldn't connect, is right 73% of the time, cannot explain how. Three of the remaining 27% are spectacular failures.

tagline: Has been awake for 31 hours. Is somehow winning.
backstory: Dropped out twice. Returned to a community college to audit one (1) course on game theory. Runs an anonymous Twitter account with 12k followers that only posts at 3am. Was banned from a Discord for being correct about something in the wrong tone. Has never had a LinkedIn.

rival.name: The Credential
rival.description: Ivy League. Well-rested. Cannot predict what Dev will say next and it is eating him alive.

mentor.name: An Old Forum Post
mentor.description: From 2009. Author unknown. Dev has it memorized. Returns to it when nothing else works.

final_form_locked: Final Form: The Pattern Saint — unlocks after Episode 7.
opening_line: He was wrong about one thing. He was wrong spectacularly. He was right about everything else.
